title: Fix task Clear and callback bundles after code-only Dag changes
body:
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
     https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 -->

A change to a task callable can advance a versioned bundle without changing the
serialized Dag. Airflow then reuses the Dag-version record and updates its bundle
metadata in place, while existing runs stay pinned to their original bundle in
`DagRun.bundle_version`. The Dag version therefore no longer tells which code a
run executes.

#71425 made `run_on_latest_version` repin active runs in that case. This PR fixes
the remaining places that still read the bundle from the Dag version:

- **Task Clear dialog:** compares the latest bundle with the parent run's bundle
  instead of the task instance's Dag version, so "Run on latest version" is
  offered when the run would otherwise execute historical code. Clearing all
  mapped instances had no bundle to compare and never offered the option for a
  bundle-only change; it now uses the run's bundle too. When the clear targets a
  single run, confirmation waits until the run and Dag metadata have loaded.
- **Task callbacks:** failure callbacks and email requests for externally
  killed, heartbeat-timed-out and stuck-in-queued tasks, and the callbacks the
  triggerer sends when a deferred task finishes, use `DagRun.bundle_version`
  and the bundle manifest (`version_data`) of the run's pinned Dag version,
  matching the bundle the task workload ran with. Task execution and callbacks
  send that manifest only while the Dag version still describes the pinned
  bundle, since a code-only update overwrites it in place. The email path also ignored
  unpinned runs (`disable_bundle_versioning`), the case #72370 targeted; it now
  shares the callback resolution.

No API schema change or database migration is required.

related: #71425
